notes: closed maps only; no per-entry special cases; every derived value is traceable to source columns recorded in a2-derivation-log.jsonl
scope: legacy pool domain/tier/solvable backfill + domain vocabulary normalization

AB.applies_to: products whose source batch is A or B (domain empty)

rules.def: domain = CATEGORY_MAP[category]; category read from call.category (B batch) or rule.metadata.category (A batch) via provenance.src back-link
tier = 'light' (default grant; full awaits service-family channel backfill, hook metadata.intake.tier_grant_basis)
solvable = [output] when output non-empty else []; output read from call.output (B batch) or rule.domain.output (A batch)
metadata.subdomain = subcategory when subcategory non-empty (side-channel preservation)

C.applies_to: products whose source batch is C (composite domain 'field / subdomain' filled by A1)

rules.def: domain = FIELD_MAP[field]; the composite 'field / subdomain' value is split, field mapped to domain-catalog id
tier untouched (A1 legacy values: computability partial->light x118, full->full x14)
solvable: fill [] when missing (source eval_output/provenance output empty); A1 legacy non-empty values untouched
metadata.subdomain = composite sub-domain component when absent (side-channel preservation)

title: A2 metadata derivation rule tables (two tables, never mixed)
